visual.general_description: Color photograph of an infant lying on a blanket, seen from the front, with a red opaque bar over the eyes and a yellow arrow at the side of the neck near the jaw.
visual.detailed_description: The photograph shows an infant lying on their back on a cream-colored blanket with an orange patch, head toward the top of the frame. A solid red bar is drawn across the upper face covering the eyes and brow; the nose, mouth and chin below it are visible, and the mouth is slightly open. The infant wears a light blue long-sleeved top with teal cuffs and a pale yellow-green layer with a light blue appliqué over the chest; one small hand rests at the lower left. A hand-drawn yellow arrow on the right side of the image points toward the side of the neck just below the jaw, where a gray-white fabric collar fold lies against the skin. The skin at the tip of the arrow is partly covered by this collar fold, and no separate swelling can be made out at this resolution. There are no panel letters, scale bars, text labels, dates or other legible identifiers in the image.
